title: DMT laser diffraction shows the same symbols

tellings.quote: they found that everybody was seeing these same symbols when they did Shine a laser a certain way

plain: People who took the psychedelic drug DMT reportedly all saw the same symbols when a laser was shone a certain way. A guest named Randy Anderson, who says he saw alien technology at a military base, tells Michels this second-hand, as something he heard from a man named Danny Jones: "everybody was seeing these same symbols." If true, it would suggest the visions are not random, and that different people are seeing something that is really there.
